about.registryInfo: Title to this property is held by NDP d.o.o., a Slovenian company established in 2015 by Blocksquare co-founder and chief executive Denis Petrovcic, whose stated activity is managing real estate for private investors. NDP manages the tenancy and distributes rental revenue in DAI to token holders under a corporate resolution allocating eighty five percent of revenues annually. Company registration number and registered address were not supplied. Property records are held in the Blocksquare property registry at 0x05325C1Ab1440df7214dB38F676F95999729267B on Ethereum.
